name: split-allocator
title: Split Allocator
description: Split editor that shows what's left as you type, gives the rest to any row in one tap, flags rows on 0, and rounds every automatic split with largest remainder so it sums to the total exactly (100 / 3 → 34, 33, 33).

meta.summary: Keeps splits adding up to exactly the total, showing what's left as you type and rounding automatic splits so nothing is off by one.
catches: Remainder, assignable to any row in one tap
Automatic splits that would drift by rounding, fixed with largest-remainder
limits: Even and proportional splits only; custom rules are yours
Uses decimal precision you set; currency minor units must match
a11y: Group labelled by its label; each row input has a <label>
aria-invalid when over the total; status in a polite live region via aria-describedby
Give-rest/take-over buttons have aria-labels with the amount
Progress bar is aria-hidden; the numbers are in text
